description:
Save a new revision of a schema proposal by publishing changed subgraph schemas to its proposal variant, the same action as Save revision in GraphOS Studio.
GraphOS composes the proposal variant, records the diff against the source variant, and runs schema checks on it.
The source variant does not change.
Send only the subgraphs that change, each with its full SDL. previousLaunchId must be the proposal variant's latest launch ID from GetProposal.
If someone saved a revision since, the call fails, so read the proposal again before you retry.
GraphOS saves the revision even when the schema does not compose, so this call succeeding does not mean the change is valid.
Call GetProposal after the check finishes: latestRevision.checkWorkflow.status and latestRevision.launch.status show the result, and GetCheckResults takes the check ID for the details.
Returns the proposal's new latest revision, or an error with a message.
Provide the graph ID, the proposal variant name, previousLaunchId, a unique revision label, a summary of the change, and the subgraphs.

GitContextInput.description: This is stored with a schema when it is uploaded

branch.description: The Git repository branch used in the check.

commit.description: The ID of the Git commit used in the check.

committer.description: The username of the user who created the Git commit used in the check.

message.description: The commit message of the Git commit used in the check.

PartialSchemaInput.description:
Input for registering a partial schema to an implementing service.
One of the fields must be specified (validated server-side).

If a new partialSchemaSDL is passed in, this operation will store it before
creating the association.

If both the sdl and hash are specified, an error will be thrown if the provided
hash doesn't match our hash of the sdl contents. If the sdl field is specified,
the hash does not need to be and will be computed server-side.

hash.description:
Hash of the partial schema to associate; error is thrown if only the hash is
specified and the hash has not been seen before

sdl.description:
Contents of the partial schema in SDL syntax, but may reference types
that aren't defined in this document

name: PublishProposalRevision
